title: Revise parallel-jobs design per review 2 changes N1–N6
summary: Edit docs/design/parallel-jobs.md to apply review 2 section 4: N1 (local landing stays in the child, ordered by the repository lock; say who runs land --pr), then N2, N3, and the low items N4–N6 and closing question 9. Add a CHANGELOG.md entry in the usual style. No code.

acceptance_criteria.text: Section 7 point 2 and section 8 of parallel-jobs.md state that local landing stays in the child, ordered by the repository lock, and say who runs land --pr and when; the claim that the rebuild precedes the next landing check is removed (N1).
The doc states section 9 rules 1 and 2 take effect with the build and rule 3 is the working rule before then (N2).
The doc says how the launcher distinguishes locked, refused, error and reread, without relying on message text, and the --json field list for reread is corrected (N3).

N4 (open-PR exit code matches single-job command), N5 (--all default not buying work expected to go stale) and N6 (declared-paths field named as in the repository) are applied, and question 9 is marked closed.
Only docs/design/parallel-jobs.md and CHANGELOG.md change; the CHANGELOG entry is under [Unreleased] in the existing style.
Run git diff --stat and git status: only those two files are changed; cargo fmt --check still passes.
